records.email_subject: Collaboration with EDXSO: AI & Python Content for DevBytes AI
records.email_body:
Hi DevBytes AI,

We're genuinely impressed by your 'Building Full-Stack AI with Python' video and your insightful tutorials on Python, FastAPI, and OpenAI. Your focus on building modern software and AI pipelines perfectly aligns with EDXSO's mission to empower developers with next-generation AI-powered career training and interactive tools. We'd love to explore a paid sponsorship ($250-$800) and offer free Pro access to your community. Let's discuss how we can create valuable content together. Reply here or book a quick chat: cal.com/edxso/partnerships.
